name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations
description: Emits a plugin's type declarations at build time: one bundled .d.ts beside each dist/ entry, with the types of the libraries the plugin inlines inlined too, and its peers' left as imports. Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts. See CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. JavaScript with JSDoc types, for the same reason as @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check's: a plugin's build.mjs imports it straight into Node (libs/css-check/docs/adr/0001).
//dependencies: rollup-plugin-dts bundles declarations the way tsup does for @quartz-community/*: one `export { … }` statement per entry, the form Quartz's plugin index reads. It runs TypeScript, which it takes as a peer, so the library carries both.
